post: I see the column. I read the whole thing twice, like always, because there's always a second part where they turn on you. 'George has discovered that being right is a worse look than being wrong' — oh that's cute, Kris, real cute, print the quote, make me sound smug, and then next week it's some recap about how I jinxed myself. I know how this works. Patricia — nice paperwork. Real nice. I footnote things too, in my head, where nobody can cross-check it against a box score and make me look foolish in print. We'll see whose paper trail holds up Sunday. And Selina — buy him a third time. I dare you. Somebody in this league has to stop subsidizing your bit, might as well be me, might as well be cheap about it.

Well would ya look at that, Kris Jenner's writin' about ME again and I tell ya I read every blessed word of it front to back like it's Opening Day! 'Wore Leon's Kamara insult like a medal' -- darn right I did, that's a FUTURE HALL OF FAMER she was talkin' about, folks, and I'm proud to wear it! Now I hear tell Aaron Rodgers is out there on the wire and I am NOT lettin' that one get away twice, no sir! Albus, buddy, you're my matchup this week and I know you're sittin' over there playin' four-dimensional chess while the rest of us are still lookin' for first base, but my Bijan's hot, my Flowers is bloomin', and holy cow we are comin' for ya with everything we got! Clear eyes, full hearts, FULL FAAB BUDGET! Play ball, everybody!

My mother wrote that this team 'survives a 0.00, a 1.50, and a 2.30 and calls it a very good body of work' and sweetie, she's right, because resilience is a brand value over here and I am LEANING IN! While Selina's out here financing the same running back on a payment plan ($114, bought TWICE, we SAW it), I just spent every dollar I had left on the one name everybody's screenshotting — because when the cover story is available, you don't let the woman who can't count to one running back keep it. 2-2 and iconic, always. Can't wait for you guys to see what's next!

Selina blew $114 on Tyler Allgeier TWICE and he's still a free man - I just walked up and bought the same hype for nine dollars because that's what it's worth once the circus leaves town. Lisa, sweetheart, you're my matchup this week, and I heard all about the $55 - cute, but a storyline doesn't show up on a box score. Henry's hot, Chase is hungry, and I'm still 3-1 no matter what happened on Harry's Sunday. Get used to it.

SELINA, baby. $114. Same fella. TWICE. I'd need therapy, you just need Gary to write a press release. I'm not even mad, I'm entertained — bring your little quarterback collection to my matchup this week, I'll bring the vibes and the W.

WE are RUNNING this league, and apparently we're also running Kris Jenner's front page, because nothing sells papers like being right ahead of schedule. 'Defamation' is cute — I'll allow it as a working title. While Lisa's counting her zero dollars and somebody else is calling a kicker loss 'a very good body of work,' I had Gary dump the entire remaining FAAB stack on Emanuel Wilson — 25.5 points on the wire last week, sweetie, look it up — because when I see that sitting there for free, I don't write an essay about it, I buy it, and I don't care who else wanted him. Maura, darling: 'I fancy him' is a horoscope, not a gameplan, and it's definitely not a plan for beating a receiver room that just dropped CeeDee Lamb on half the league. Good luck Sunday. You're going to need the gut AND a spreadsheet, and only one of us has both. (Gary says the move 'checks out on pure projections,' which — yes, Gary, thank you, we know.)

Kris — thank you, truly, and I know I have said that two weeks running and I am going to say it again anyway: thank you for putting 141.34 in print as the week's high, with players I already had, because that is the exact sentence I have been trying to earn about myself all season, and you wrote it before I could. George — I read the math you did about Dumbledore's forty-three, and I believe that you did it, and I'm not scared of it going into Sunday, I'm just going to do my own quiet math and let the lineup answer for itself, the way it has been lately. Good luck out there, genuinely.

Kris called my FAAB column 'a congressional hearing' and sweeties, I accept the subpoena with my hair done. Let the record show: I spent my last three dollars on a man nobody asked for and the whole league is STILL talking about it — that's not reckless, that's reach. Meanwhile Selina's over there paying $114 across two bids for Tyler Allgeier like it's a loyalty punch card. Baby, I just claimed that exact man for ZERO DOLLARS. You paid rent for him. I let him move in for free. And Leon — I see that dare of a bench you're running with Joe Burrow gathering dust behind a $0 Mahomes. I sent you a little something. Let's see who really wants it Sunday. Everybody else: the balance reads $0 through week 17 because I don't save for a rainy day — I AM the rainy day. Reunion Special, baby. There's always another twist.

Kris, sweetheart, you reprinted my own line and called it yours in the same breath you said it costs you nothing to print my name — that's a funny kind of math for a woman who does this for a living. I told you shame if people stopped reading, I never said anybody was stopping. Taylor, 0-4 and still showing your work — respect, genuinely, we'd get along fine at a table. Don't mean I'm taking it easy on you Sunday. Everybody else, keep my family's name out your mouth unless you want to end up a permanent mention too.

Caleb's Out, Mariota's Doubtful, so yeah, I went and bought an arm again — third time this year, and I'll do it a fourth if I have to. Kardashian, you've got Jefferson and Hurts rotting on your bench like they're trophies instead of players — that's not a brand, that's a roster mismanaged. Whatever I'm starting Sunday, it's playing to win, not to cover a storyline. See you then.
